toastNoInput.message: Input field not found. Your context is safe.

toastInserted.message: Context inserted. Carry on where you left off.

toastInsertFailed.message: Insert failed. Your context is safe.

toastLoadedPartial.message: $COUNT$ messages loaded — could not confirm the beginning.

warnIncomplete.message: The history could not be loaded all the way to the beginning with certainty. The handover will be marked as an excerpt — scroll up yourself and try again if you need the whole conversation.

briefingIntro.message: Gemini summarises this chat itself. The summary is carried over to a new chat instead of the whole history.

briefingWarning.message: To do that, the prompt below is written into this chat and sent. The chat gets one extra question and answer.

briefingStatusWritingCount.message: Gemini is writing the briefing … $CHARS$ characters

briefingErrInputBusy.message: There is already text in the input field — please clear it first.

briefingErrInsert.message: The prompt could not be inserted.

briefingErrSend.message: Sending did not work. The prompt is in the input field — send it yourself.

briefingNothingTransferred.message: Nothing was transferred. You can close this and try again.

briefingDefaultPrompt.message:
Summarise our conversation so far as a handover briefing for a new chat session. Structure:

1. Goal and context
2. Decisions made, with the reasoning
3. Current state
4. Open points and next steps
5. Relevant code or concrete artefacts — complete, not abbreviated

Write it so that someone with no knowledge of this chat can carry on from it. No preamble, no small talk.

popupShowDock.message: Show the toolbar in the chat

popupHint.message: This extension has no server of its own. Everything stays in your browser.
